name: @equin/plugin-debug-profiling-fs-wait
description: Writes down every slow file call (packages/timed-fs: a read, listing, stat or glob scan past its floor) of a backend or a CLI run (build, check, test, supervised-exec) as one line of the fs-wait log channel of its namespace, with the process, the wait layer, the call, its target and the profiler entry it ran under — one record, the same shape wherever a disk stall lands.
